intro.text: enCore Energy Corp., America’s Clean Energy Company™, was incorporated on October 30, 2009, under the Laws of British Columbia and is a reporting issuer in all of the provinces and territories of Canada. As of January 1, 2025, the Company ceased to be a “foreign private issuer” and has become a “domestic issuer.” As of December 31, 2024, the Company filing status was a large, accelerated filer within the meanings under the Exchange Act. As of December 31, 2025, the Company’s filing status was a non-accelerated filer within the meanings under the Exchange Act. As a result, the Company must comply with the filing deadlines and disclosure obligations of a domestic issuer and non-accelerated filer as set forth in the Exchange Act. This classification impacts the timing of our periodic filings, internal control assessments, and other regulatory requirements.

net.text: (1) For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, outstanding stock options, warrants, unvested restricted stock units and the Convertible Senior Notes are excluded from the calculation of our diluted weighted average common shares outstanding as their effect would be anti-dilutive due to a net loss from continuing operations.

ocf.heading: Net Cash Used in Operating Activities
ocf.text: Net cash used in operating activities decreased by $20,212, to cash used in operating activities of $24,992, for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to cash used in operating activities of $45,204 for the year ended December 31, 2024. This is largely driven by paying off the note payable to a related party in 2025, as discussed in Note 15, offset by less purchases of uranium inventory during the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to the year ended December 31, 2024.
